subject: EMEA sponsor pass-through & geo-aware RSVP reminder windows
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, CloudBridge Partnerships <partnerships@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Ella Noble <ella.noble@cloudbridge.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: EMEA sponsor pass-through & geo-aware RSVP reminder windows

Team / CloudBridge —

Thanks again for partnering on the Nov 30 EMEA webinar. Two asks so we can lock the invite cadence today:

1) Sponsor pass-through links: CloudBridge wants their own tracking on RSVP clicks so they can attribute pipeline. We plan to pass through UTM + a sponsor_id param. I attached a CSV template with the unique sponsor_id values and the exact CTA URLs we will insert in each reminder. Please confirm these are the final URLs.

2) Geo-aware reminders (EMEA): because attendees span GMT -> +3, we should avoid sending last-minute reminders that land at 03:00 local. Proposal:
  - initial invite: Tue Nov 24 09:00 GMT
  - 3-day reminder: Fri Nov 27 staggered by region (UK/IE 09:00 GMT, CET 10:00 CET, EET 11:00 EET)
  - 24-hour reminder: Nov 29 10:00 local (respect local business hours)
  - 2-hour SMS/opt-in push: Nov 30 stagger 08:00–10:00 local depending on locale

Marissa / Vivek / Olga: can you review the windows and confirm the HubSpot tracking tokens we'll use for the sponsor pass-through? I want to make sure the sponsor gets: (a) a unique RSVP landing page view, and (b) a HubSpot referral property so CloudBridge sees MQL attribution.

Ella — can you confirm CloudBridge's preferred logo lockup (attached) and whether you want the sponsor name in the subject line for the 3-day reminder? Also confirm whether CloudBridge needs post-event attendee emails with a custom lead score tag.

Attachments: 20261120-sponsor-pass-thru-links-template.csv (stub), sponsor-cta-lockup.png (stub)

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Head of Field Marketing (EMEA)
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, CloudBridge Partnerships <partnerships@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Ella Noble <ella.noble@cloudbridge.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:34:00 +0000
Subject: Re: EMEA sponsor pass-through & geo-aware RSVP reminder windows

Jonas —

All looks sensible. A few notes from ops:

• Reminder timings: agree with stagger approach. One small change — for CET/C** we should target 10:30 local for the 3-day reminder to avoid the mid-morning meeting spike. That means: UK/IE 09:00 GMT; CET 10:30 CET; EET 11:30 EET.

• HubSpot tokens: we will use utm_source=redwood&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=emea_nov30&utm_term=sponsor_cb&utm_content={sponsor_id}. I'll populate HS-98765 with the company-specific sponsor_id and push to the campaign.

• RSVP landing pages: we can create per-sponsor landing pages under /partners/cloudbridge/rsvp?ref={sponsor_id}. That will allow per-sponsor view counts and a single-shot redirect to the canonical registration form. Olga will provision the pages and add the HubSpot form embed.

I attached suggested subject variants for localized languages (EN/DE/FR) — short subject for DE required because of CR clipping in some clients.

On branding: keep sponsor in subject only for the 3-day reminder (not initial invite or 24-hour). Less subject clutter = higher open.

If no objections I’ll queue the 3-day and 24-hour reminders for deployment on the schedule below and upload the final CSV.

—Marissa
Senior Events Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 11:47:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: EMEA sponsor pass-through & geo-aware RSVP reminder windows

Thanks, Jonas & team —

CloudBridge confirms we want:

• Unique RSVP landing page per sponsor (yes). We prefer the redirect approach you proposed so we can preserve a clean canonical registration link.

• Post-event attendee email: yes, please include a CloudBridge-specific lead score tag (cb_partner = 1) and add sponsor_source = "CB_Webinar_Nov30" to the HubSpot contact.

• Logo/lockup: attached (sponsor-cta-lockup.png). We can accept 300x90 for email header and a square 120x120 for the landing page.

A couple of questions:
1) Can you share a sample pass-through CTA URL with the full UTM + sponsor_id populated so our analytics team can validate?
2) Is there a way to include a single-click calendar add on the confirmation page that sets event time in the attendee's timezone? That will reduce no-shows.

We’ll get final legal sign-off on the co-brand copy tomorrow and confirm whether CloudBridge should appear in the subject for the 3-day reminder.

Best,
Ella
Partnerships Manager
CloudBridge
ella.noble@cloudbridge.com

To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Ella Noble <ella.noble@cloudbridge.com>, CloudBridge Partnerships <partnerships@cloudbridge.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 08:03:00 +00:00
Subject: Final: CloudBridge pass-through links + live schedule (Nov 24 queue)

Hi all — finalizing and locking. Summary + action items below.

1) CTA / pass-through URLs: attached CSV (20261124-sponsor-pass-thru-links.csv) contains the per-reminder URLs with sponsor_id populated. Sample URL: https://redwood.com/partners/cloudbridge/rsvp?ref=cb_001&utm_source=redwood&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=emea_nov30&utm_term=sponsor_cb&utm_content=cb_001. Ella — please have analytics confirm this format is acceptable.

2) Reminder schedule (confirmed):
  - Initial invite -> Tue Nov 24 09:00 GMT (EN locale)
  - 3-day reminder -> Fri Nov 27 staggered (UK/IE 09:00 GMT; CET 10:30 CET; EET 11:30 EET). Subject: "Nov 30: Live demo — CloudBridge + Redwood" (EN); DE/FR localized variants attached.
  - 24-hour reminder -> Nov 29 10:00 local (no sponsor in subject line)
  - 2-hour SMS/opt-in push -> Nov 30 08:00–10:00 local (opt-in only)

3) HubSpot / attribution: HS-98765 has been assigned; contacts created via sponsor landing will receive properties sponsor_id=cb_001, sponsor_source=CB_Webinar_Nov30, cb_partner=1. Vivek will post the list of newly-created contact records to HS-98765 after the event for CloudBridge.

4) Calendar add: we will include an ICS generator on the confirmation page that populates start time in the registrant's detected timezone. Olga will add the small snippet — should cut no-shows by ~7–10%.

5) Branding + assets: sponsor-cta-lockup.png (300x90) included. If CloudBridge approves, Marissa will push the 3-day subject variant that mentions CloudBridge.

Next steps / action owners:
  - CloudBridge (Ella): confirm analytics sign-off on sample URL, reply with final legal copy by EOD 11/24.
  - Olga: provision the per-sponsor redirect landing pages and confirm HubSpot form embed by 11/24 17:00 CET.
  - Marissa: queue creative and localized subject lines for deployment; schedule sends in HubSpot.
  - Vivek: post-event contact handoff process and lead score propagation.

Attachments: 20261124-sponsor-pass-thru-links.csv (final), sponsor-cta-lockup.png

Thanks everyone —
Jonas
Head of Field Marketing (EMEA)
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
